say:1:1530202401:1.text: Yeah... most of them fell on the battlefield.
say:1:1530202401:1.source_cn: 嗯……很多人都死在了战场上。
say:1:1530202401:1.male: Yeah... most of them fell on the battlefield.
say:1:1530202401:1.female: Yeah... most of them fell on the battlefield.

say:2:1530202402:1.text: Spelto, Kaan... and so many others. I might not remember every name, but I'll never forget their faces.
say:2:1530202402:1.source_cn: 斯皮尔特、卡安……还有很多我都面熟，但是未必叫得上名字...
say:2:1530202402:1.male: Spelto, Kaan... and so many others. I might not remember every name, but I'll never forget their faces.
say:2:1530202402:1.female: Spelto, Kaan... and so many others. I might not remember every name, but I'll never forget their faces.

say:3:1530202403:1.text: I have no friends left... Not a single one.
say:3:1530202403:1.source_cn: 我的朋友……一个都没有了。
say:3:1530202403:1.male: I have no friends left... Not a single one.
say:3:1530202403:1.female: I have no friends left... Not a single one.
